page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors clocked at 2.5 GHz. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 52 dedicated vCPUs along with 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of roughly 3.69 GB per virtual core. The instance operates without discrete hardware acceleration, dedicating all physical host resources to compute and memory tasks.

Storage on the instance relies entirely on external network-attached block volumes, as zero local disk storage is bundled with the configuration. For inter-system communication and external data transit, it is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included, necessitating the attachment of elastic IP configurations for direct public access.

With a high core count and commensurate memory footprint, this configuration offers solid compute and memory density without the cost overhead associated with attached accelerators or excess peripheral resources. The hardware configuration makes this server suited for running enterprise application backends, mid-sized relational database deployments, distributed caching systems, batch processing jobs, and large-scale container orchestration nodes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on KVM virtualization and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance provisions 52 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of RAM, offering an allocation of approximately 3.69 GB of memory per core. It operates with 12 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and includes no local disks, meaning persistent storage depends entirely on remote block storage solutions. Furthermore, it contains no discrete GPU accelerators and allocates no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With its balanced processor and memory profile, ecs.g6.13xlarge offers efficient resource utilization across heavy multi-threaded enterprise workloads, making it well matched for enterprise application servers, mid-sized relational database management systems, caching tiers, continuous integration pipelines, and horizontally scaled container orchestration environments.
